text: Bonsoir, I am the grandmother, I am looking after my petit-fils tonight, he is 3 months old. His temprature was 39.3 when I checked it with the thermometre under the arm, mon dieu I have checked it maybe five times now. His parents are away until tomorow and I am so tired, I have not slept since 4 this morning. We gave him the paracetamol, the right dose for his age, it is written on the box and I checked with my daughter on the phone. In between the doses he is playing on his mat, he is taking his bottle very well, he finished the whole thing, and he is making all his little noises and chatting to me, vraiment he is smiling. But the temperature keeps coming back up when the medicine wears off. I do not know if this is normal for such a small baby, in my time we did things differently and I do not want to do something wrong with him. Je suis épuisée, please tell me what I should do, if I should wait until morning or take him somewhere tonight.
